text:
maria: Quick design check — updated the Preview simulation UI and legend. Moved the legend to the left rail, changed priority chips from colored pills to outlined numeric badges, added keyboard reorder affordance (drag handle + keyboard grab), and tightened validation copy. Screenshot: https://img.redwood/test/preview-legend.png

devin: taking a look. Are the new chip colors WCAG-contrast checked? :thinking:

maria: good call — I ran a quick check, some chips hit ~3.2:1 on dark mode. thinking to add 1px border and slightly darker text.

sam: for keyboard reordering: can we use a `aria-grabbed` pattern? example:
```html
<button class="reorder-handle" aria-label="Grab to reorder rule 'Block long prompts'" aria-pressed="false">≡</button>
```
This keeps it simple for SR users.

anish: agree with border. Also ensure focus ring is visible: don't rely on color alone. Validation messages need to be programmatically linked to the offending rule (aria-describedby -> id).

olivia: microcopy tweak: current 'Rules conflict' -> propose: 'Conflicting routing rules detected. Reorder or refine conditions to resolve.' It's more actionable.

maria: +1 olivia. Also thinking to show a small numeric badge on the left of each rule in preview to indicate evaluated priority index.

jules: simulation should highlight matched rule in context of the sample request, not just show the list. maybe dim non-matching rules and show animated pulse on matched rule for 1.5s.

devin: animation ok but keep prefers-reduced-motion respect. Also the dimming relies on contrast — check disabled text contrast.

paul: one more: keyboard shortcut to toggle preview: `Shift+P`. Add hint in header — helps power users.

lisa-bot: accessibility-check failed for new chip color in dark mode (contrast ratio 3.18:1) — see report: https://ci.redwood/a11y/1789012345

maria: thanks — will update color + add border. Anyone object to adding 'aria-live' region that announces 'Preview applied, rule X matched' when simulation runs?

anish: yes to aria-live, but keep polite wording and low verbosity.

sam: will mock updated CSS and microcopy, drop in a Figma and link when ready.

maria: great — leave any final a11y nits here, else I'll ship the change to the staging branch tomorrow. :thumbsup:
